# Image Distillation Loop (JEV Edition)

> **Wesley learns to generate images via JEV-Diffusion.** No actual image generator. The "image" is a refined text description composed of substrate cells.

## What's new vs the original

| Original | JEV Edition |
|---|---|
| Real diffusion (SD Turbo / SD 1.5) | JEV-Diffusion (LLM-as-GAN) |
| 6GB VRAM student | No GPU needed |
| Image pixels | Substrate cells with prev_hash |
| Silent retry | Auditable feedback chain |

## Architecture

```
TEACHER (JEV plans + Qwen renders cells) → Reference description
        ↓
STUDENT (JEV plans + alternating Qwen/DeepSeek) → Candidate description
        ↓
SCORER (Qwen 4-dimension schema) → Score
        ↓
FEEDBACK (DeepSeek) → "What makes the reference better"
        ↓
RETRY with improved prompt → Better candidate?
        ↓
REFLEX COMPILER (feedback → substrate cell) → Saved as audit trail
```

Every iteration is a substrate cell with prev_hash chain. No black box.

## Quick Start

```bash
pip install -e ".[dev]"
export TYPESAFEAI_KEY=...
export DEEPINFRA_TOKEN=...
export DEEPSEEK_TOKEN=...

python -m image_distill --prompt "fishing boat at dawn" --iterations 5 --preset landscape
```

## Substrate cell structure

```json
{
  "iteration": 1,
  "prompt": "fishing boat at dawn",
  "candidate_description": "...",
  "candidate_cells": [
    {"cell_id": "wesley-sky", "region": "sky", "content": "...", "hash": "0x..."}
  ],
  "score": {"completeness": 8, "specificity": 9, "coherence": 8, "composition": 9},
  "feedback": {"summary": "...", "suggestions": [...]},
  "prev_hash": "0x...",
  "cell_hash": "0x..."
}
```
